headline: sources/ is 6,538 tracked files, 1,557 MiB and 4.88M Markdown words. Most of the words are AI-written: Codex session workspaces (1.57M), Ren's earlier projects built with agents (2.28M) and agent reports inside the prompts export (0.57M). Most of the bytes are data that experiments read. Ren's verbatim words are a small, well-kept part, chiefly in group 15. The area's rule ("never edited, never moved") protects the AI snapshots as fully as his words. His 14 to 17 November words sit in two long files that no hand-kept register lists.

loadBearingClaims.claim: sources/ holds 6,538 tracked files (2,258 .md, 4,876,860 Markdown words, 1,632,761,356 bytes). Groups 12, 13 and 18 are not tracked.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: git -c core.quotepath=off ls-files -z sources, summed with os.path.getsize and len(text.split()) for .md files; .gitignore lines 15-17

loadBearingClaims.claim: Inside sources/, 1,181 non-empty files are extra byte-identical copies of other sources files (68 MB, 848,540 md words, 17% of the area's words); 1,081 of them are in group 20.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: git ls-files -s -z sources, grouped by blob sha, counting every copy past the first in sorted order

loadBearingClaims.claim: In sources/14-claude-code-prompts, 572,028 of 664,774 words (86%) lie inside <\task-notification> blocks, which hold subagent reports, not Ren's prompts.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: re.finditer(r'<\task-notification>.*?<\/task-notification>', re.S) over the 17 files; sampled Users-ren-repos-bonfire.md

loadBearingClaims.claim: Ren's words of 13 to 17 November on the direction are filed in only two files (2026-11-13-the-map-one-model.md and 2026-11-16-no-corners-the-interconnected-map.md). RESEARCH-DIRECTIVES.md mentions neither (0 matches, latest date 2026-11-13). SOURCES.md has 3 lines dated 2026-11 and was last changed on 11 November.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: git show --name-only on the filing commits 3d4aa3162, f5a027014, b81838022, 290843ad6, 433ef0013; grep -c on the register; git log -1 on SOURCES.md
loadBearingClaims.howFarSeen: counted; the two files read in part

loadBearingClaims.claim: No sources/GROUPS.json or sources/MANIFEST.tsv exists, in the tree or in git history, though _process/REPOSITORY-LAYOUT.md line 49 names GROUPS.json. sources/README.md is generated by tools/research/indexes.py from the directory listing.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: find for GROUPS.json; git log --all -- sources/GROUPS.json is empty; ls sources/MANIFEST.tsv fails; indexes.py lines 386-416

loadBearingClaims.claim: Non-history Markdown outside sources/ holds 2,845 links into sources/ from 809 files, 2,319 of them to group 15; across all link sources, 276 links carry a #anchor. 3,999 more links come from history, frozen or -BEFORE- paths.
loadBearingClaims.howFarSeen: counted by regex (a few links may be missed)

loadBearingClaims.claim: Only 22 non-history files outside sources/ reference group 20, and 617 lines in 119 files outside sources/ match 'sources/2[0-5]-'. The 16 October review's 'about 67k receipt references' is not reproduced at HEAD.

Since 17 October, no original in an imported group was modified: modifications touched 48 group-15 records, the two index files and PROVENANCE/README files of zhouyi-yizhuan and materialist-dialectics. The only deletions were the 697 private files untracked in cbe909fe9 (19 October), which remain in origin/main history.
loadBearingClaims.evidence: git log --since=2026-10-17 --diff-filter=M and --diff-filter=D --name-only -- sources; git log origin/main -- sources/12-claude-ai-chats

againstTheViews: Against 'much is garbage': most bytes are data that experiments and verifiers read by path and manifests hash, and the group-15 records are carefully kept (time stamps, typed or spoken, AI context labelled).

Against 'trace and machine output can leave without loss': the 2.28M words of groups 00-11 are Ren's earlier projects, the only copy, not trace and not regenerable. Group 14 mixes his prompts with agent reports.
For the second view: group 20 is AI session trace of 1.47M words, about a third of it internal snapshot copies, with only 22 non-history citers.
Neither view: the area's own rule ('source: never edited, never moved' in paths.py) protects AI snapshots like Ren's words. That is why 1.5M AI words live beside his words instead of under history.
notDetermined: Which sentences in groups 03-10 are in Ren's own hand and which an agent's.
Near copies (re-saved with edits) between sources and earlier-telling folders were not measured; only byte-identical copies were.
